errors.root_cause: Does not understand that denominators represent the size of parts, not quantities
errors.remediation: Use visual fraction bars. Show that 1/2 + 1/3 cannot be 2/5 because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

errors.root_cause: Does not understand that parts must be the same size to add
errors.remediation: Use pizza/cake analogy. You can't add half a pizza and quarter a pizza without cutting into same-sized slices.
